items.headline: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
items.summary: Investment titan Warren Buffett has officially stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, concluding his management role at the conglomerate he led for decades. His son, Howard Buffett, is taking over as non-executive chairman to help preserve the company's corporate culture alongside chief executive Greg Abel.

items.headline: NASA Discovers Largest Newly Formed Impact Crater on the Moon
items.summary: NASA announced that its Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter discovered a 728-foot-wide crater created by a recent space rock impact on the Moon. Released on September 18, 2026, this milestone finding represents the largest newly formed impact crater ever identified by scientists in the solar system.

items.headline: 2026 Asian Games Open in Japan Amid Debates Over Unconventional Lodging
items.summary: The 20th Asian Games officially began on September 19 in Nagoya, Japan, bringing together over 11,000 athletes competing across 43 different sports. Tournament officials defended using a cruise ship and converted shipping containers as lodging to lower event costs following complaints about cramped conditions.

items.headline: New Resident Evil Movie Reboot Sets Franchise Box Office Record
items.summary: Director Zach Cregger's new Resident Evil film reboot earned $8.8 million in Thursday previews, setting up a record-breaking opening weekend projected to cross $50 million. Strong critical reviews have sparked widespread audience enthusiasm and revitalized the long-running video game film series.
